import ColourTween from 'color-tween';
import Color from 'color';
 
export function rgbToHex(rgbValue: string) {
    Iif (rgbValue.includes('#')) {
        return rgbValue;
    }
 
    rgbValue = rgbValue.split('(')[1].split(')')[0];
 
    const values = rgbValue.split(',');
    const hexValue = values.map((value) => {
        const base16Value = parseInt(value, 10).toString(16);
        return (base16Value.length === 1) ? '0' + base16Value : base16Value;
    }).join('');
 
    return `#${hexValue}`;
}
 
export function getColourSteps(startColor: string, endColor: string, Isteps: number = 100) {
    startColor = startColor.replace(/[^0-9A-F]/gi, '');
    endColor = endColor.replace(/[^0-9A-F]/gi, '');
 
    let i: number;
    const startR = parseInt(startColor.slice(0, 2), 16);
    const startG = parseInt(startColor.slice(2, 4), 16);
    const startB = parseInt(startColor.slice(4, 6), 16);
    const endR = parseInt(endColor.slice(0, 2), 16);
    const endG = parseInt(endColor.slice(2, 4), 16);
    const endB = parseInt(endColor.slice(4, 6), 16);
    const diffR = ((endR - startR) / steps);
    const diffG = ((endG - startG) / steps);
    const diffB = ((endB - startB) / steps);
    const stepsHex: string[] = [];
    let hexR: number | string;
    let hexG: number | string;
    let hexB: number | string;
 
    for (i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
        hexR = Math.round(startR + (diffR * i));
        hexG = Math.round(startG + (diffG * i));
        hexB = Math.round(startB + (diffB * i));
 
        hexR = hexR < 16 ? '0' + hexR.toString(16) : hexR.toString(16);
        hexG = hexG < 16 ? '0' + hexG.toString(16) : hexG.toString(16);
        hexB = hexB < 16 ? '0' + hexB.toString(16) : hexB.toString(16);
 
        stepsHex[i] = '#' + hexR + '' + hexG + '' + hexB;
    }
 
    return stepsHex;
}
 
// eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/default-param-last
export function tweenBetweenColours(startColour: string, endColour: string, Iduration: number = 1, onUpdate: (colour: Color) => void) {
    const tween = new ColourTween(startColour, endColour).duration(duration * 1000).onUpdate((colour: Color) => onUpdate(colour));
    let requestAnimationFrameId: number;
    const animate = () => {
        Iif (tween.update()) {
            requestAnimationFrameId = window.requestAnimationFrame(animate);
        }
    };
 
    tween.start(animate);
    return () => window.cancelAnimationFrame(requestAnimationFrameId);
}
